name: Hearing God
overview: Scripture reveals that hearing God involves both divine guidance and human response. God promises to instruct and counsel His people, guiding them in the way they should go, as seen in Psalms 32:8 and Isaiah 30:21. Hearing God is not merely about listening but also about obedience, for Jesus declares that those who hear and keep God's word are truly blessed (Luke 11:28). Moreover, hearing God's words is a spiritual reality, accessible only to those who belong to God (John 8:47), and it brings life through the Spirit (John 6:63). God invites His people to call upon Him, promising to reveal great and hidden things, emphasizing the intimate communication between God and His followers (Jeremiah 33:3).
